title: I9: Tolra evidence map for quality records
public_pr_body:
Short source-linked map of existing quality-record support, with honest limits for history, document control, permissions, job/material links, problems/inspection, delivery and suppliers. Dedicated complaint and full corrective-action workflows are marked as gaps.

Tolra supports JNR’s quality work; software/documents cannot certify JNR. JNR is audited.

- [x] Source and whitespace checks; published tree matches local commit.
- [ ] John/Rhys reviews actual installed system, company decisions and evidence.

Builder 5 / I9, explicit Rhys assignment; atomic claim claims/I9. One document under docs/iso9001/, independent of other drafts. No runtime tests or live exports run. No feature build, Ready label, main merge or production SQL. Builders 3/4 unchanged. Handover and remaining decisions are recorded in the document; existing I1–I7 drafts remain unchanged.
